title: Indonesia's constitution allows a state of emergency, with the conditions regulated by law
summary: Indonesia's constitution allows a state of emergency, with the conditions regulated by law.
body: Article 12 says the president may declare a state of emergency, and that the conditions for the declaration and the subsequent measures shall be regulated by law. The source says: "Emergency provisions Article 12 The President may declare a state of emergency." The constitution grants the power and sends the conditions to statute. It does not, in this article, list those conditions.
